description: Total Chaos (Wad Squad 2018) -- standalone survival-horror total conversion via GZDoom
long: Total Chaos is a standalone survival-horror total conversion built on the GZDoom engine, set on a desolate island where the player scavenges for resources and weapons while fending off mutated creatures. It blends atmospheric exploration and resource scarcity with Doom-derived combat. It was created by Wad Squad and released free in 2018.
